title: Write features/daw/kit-midi.feature and its steps; watch them fail
description:
## Intent

Specs first for the MIDI export.

## Scope

- `features/daw/kit-midi.feature` with every scenario of the stories apricitus-92ad82 and apricitus-ae1460; new steps added to `features/daw/STEPS.md` (reading a `.mid`: notes, ticks, tempo, time signature).
- Step definitions in `crates/apricity-daw/tests/conformance.rs`; timing checks compare against `apricity compile` output (the timeline's events), not against internals.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test conformance
```
New scenarios fail for the right reason (no `--steps`); output in a comment.

## Release

`test(<this task id>): specs for the kit track's MIDI`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by M1's CLI task (apricitus-c1a8b5).
